limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: Finite digital model, no physical pressure or thermal accuracy conclusion.
Shared BDU retention until PRESS_OUT_H follows Rev6 p38; exact DA clear byte is unspecified and separately stressed.
SUB7 single-byte alias follows p26; contradictory multiple-byte prose at p27 does not authorize forbidden BDU I2C bursts.
Reset completion uses a 1ms model stimulus, not a manufacturer maximum; activity while pending is model_unsupported.
Unmodeled FIFO, offset/calibration, reboot and reserved operations are not declared universally invalid hardware operations.
Pressure encoding extrema outside 260..1260hPa are oracle-only; unsigned HIL does not imply signed encoding is unsigned.
History permits caches; repeated stable-input changes test useful progress, not one conversion per request.
Diagnostics record fault policy; a core pass does not prove all fault recovery.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile candidate code.
